card.sourceText: @yatharth170699 on the local fallback, if each gateway keeps the full per-customer quota, the effective limit during a redis outage becomes quota times gateway count. dividing by the number of live instances keeps it close, though autoscaling makes that count fuzzy right when you need it.

behavior.reasonToExist: His autoscaling caveat has a sharper consequence: the instance count is least trustworthy during the exact spike the fallback exists for.
